review_comment: The code directly uses externally provided 'options.trustedOrigins' input in a security-sensitive cross-origin check without validation. The incorrect assignment of push() return value corrupts the origins array, potentially allowing untrusted origins to bypass security checks. Add proper input validation and ensure correct array modification using 'origins.push(options.trustedOrigins)' instead of 'origins = origins.push(options.trustedOrigins)'.
